resources.string: Hammer stores your projects in a folder you choose, so your writing stays in your hands.\n\nOn the next screen, pick an existing hammer projects folder or create a new one. You can change this later in Settings.
Choisissez où stocker vos projets Hammer
Hammer needs a folder to store your projects.\nChoose a folder now, or quit.
Un outil simple pour construire des histoires.
